item.title: You Only Have Three Servers, Why Are You Using Kubernetes?
item.description: Kubernetes is for Google, systemd is for the rest of us. The story of someone who spent three months learning K8s, only to realize a single config file would have done the job.

item.title: I Slimmed a Docker Image from 2GB to 50MB: A Hands-on Postmortem
item.description: The real steps and trade-offs I took to cut a Docker image from 2GB down to 50MB — pitfalls, decisions, and practical takeaways without the fluff.

item.title: Rust Axum Graceful Shutdown, The Ultimate Guide: Fix the pitfall 99% of engineers hit
item.description: Master graceful shutdown for Rust Axum services: listen for SIGINT/SIGTERM, refuse new connections with with_graceful_shutdown, stop background tasks via CancellationToken, set timeouts, and integrate with Docker/Kubernetes termination — protect data integrity and user experience.
